Applies once an employer's annual wages exceed the NSW threshold; grouped entities across locations must consolidate wages.
Levied on land above the threshold; a surcharge applies to foreign and absentee owners of NSW residential property.
Payable on property transfers; first-home-buyer and other concessions may apply.
Employer premium based on wages and industry rate, reconciled annually.

Applies once an employer's annual wages exceed the NSW threshold; grouped entities across locations must consolidate wages.
Levied on land above the threshold; a surcharge applies to foreign and absentee owners of NSW residential property.
Payable on property transfers; first-home-buyer and other concessions may apply.
Employer premium based on wages and industry rate, reconciled annually.
